summary: Regolo's startup partnership: 60 days of free unlimited tokens (up to 50M tokens/day) across 100+ open-source models on EU-hosted, zero-data-retention, OpenAI-compatible infrastructure. No credit card for the free period; applications reviewed within ~48 hours. In return, accepted startups do light co-marketing (logo, content, mentions). Active teams can later apply for a voucher up to €2,000 valid up to 12 months.
claim_steps: Apply via the Builder Program form at https://regolo.ai/builder-program/ (applications reviewed within 48 hours, cohorts limited).
No credit card needed for the 60-day free period.
Accepted startups add the Regolo logo to their site and publish real usage content.
